messages:
maria (Docs): Heads-up — PR #8427 is ready for final review. This is the migration guide for the SDK config flags; it contains one sensitive snippet that legal requested redaction on. CI preview: https://ci.redwood/preview/8427 :eyes:
kevin (DevEx): saw the PR, looks good overall. who is the final reviewer for docs and legal? I can block merge until both sign off.
sam (Eng-Infra): FYI deploy-bot flagged a lint failure on the code block formatting — should be a quick fix. Not a blocker for approvals, but the docs preview will show weird rendering until fixed.
maria (Docs): thanks @sam — fixing the fenced block now. Legal asked for an explicit redaction note around the KMS snippet. They gave two options: remove the literal key placeholder or replace it with a redaction callout. Which do we prefer?
emma (Security): prefer the redaction callout + example with sanitized values. Legal wants the real usage pattern visible but no customer-identifiable data. Something like:
```
// DO NOT include real keys here — redact before publishing
const client = new KMSClient({ key: 'REDACTED_EXAMPLE' });
```
That satisfies auditors.
legal-bot: @maria — legal reviewed the redaction approach. Please add the following blurb in the PR description: "Sensitive snippet redacted per legal guidance; full example available to enterprise customers under NDA." Once present, we can sign off.
kevin (DevEx): small coordination note: docs CI preview is on a 10-min rebuild cadence. If we want the green preview before EOD merge, aim to push fixes within the next 30 minutes. Also add reviewers: @kevin and @emma for last check, and tag @security for FYI.
maria (Docs): added legal blurb to the PR description and replaced snippet with sanitized example. Pushed a fix and updated reviewers. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/8427
sam (Eng-Infra): lint fixed, preview rebuilt. Preview link: https://ci.redwood/preview/8427/3 (now renders properly).
emma (Security): quick pass done — redaction callout looks good. Left one inline comment about keeping the telemetry example generic.
kevin (DevEx): approved in the PR, left a note about adding an explicit QA checklist for the migration to avoid regressions.
legal-bot: legal sign-off recorded. Reference: LEG-2026-PR8427.
maria (Docs): great — since we have legal + security + docs approvals, I plan to merge tomorrow 09:30 PT to align with the weekly cut and avoid interfering with infra deploys. Any objections?
emma (Security): no objections from security.
sam (Eng-Infra): good timing — infra has a maintenance window at 10:00 PT, so 09:30 is fine.
kevin (DevEx): no objections. Please squash commits and use conventional-changelog format in the merge message.
maria (Docs): will do the squash + changelog. merging tomorrow at 09:30 PT unless someone raises a last-minute issue. :thumbsup:
kevin (DevEx): thanks — can you add a short note in #release-war-room when it goes live? helps SRE and support.
maria (Docs): yep will post a short blurb after merge with the preview URL and a note about redaction guidance.
